items.title: MEASURE layer: no measurement of whether improvements actually help
items.resolution: Valid meta-observation. Not actionable as a single task — needs a measurement strategy (instrument AGENTS.md rule violations, track improvement vs regression). Suitable for a /tp explore session, not immediate implementation.

items.title: Harvest arm-verify-collect chain is unused
items.resolution: Specific to harvest implementation. The arm-verify-collect chain exists but close is used more than collect. This is a workflow adoption issue, not a code bug. Monitor.

items.title: Pause-on-N-errors: quality-gate should nudge after consecutive tool failures
items.resolution: Actionable. Add detect_consecutive_errors to quality_gate.py PreToolUse hook. Count errors per session, emit nudge at threshold N=2. Suitable for /go implementation next session. Create handoff.

items.title: Literal-vs-intent interpretation: track as recurring failure mode
items.resolution: Already partially covered by agent-failure-modes-2026.md. Pattern is known. Track frequency; if it increases, propose AGENTS.md rule.
